title: Phase
description: A competency cluster. The last topic of every phase is a capstone.

uuid.description: Stable identifier. Never changes, even if name or slug does.

name.description: Display name, e.g. 'AI and LLM Foundations'.

short_description.description: One line, for cards and listings.

description.description: Full paragraph shown on the phase page.

topics.description: Ordered topic slugs. This list, not the filenames, defines display order.

hands_on_verification.description: Slugs of the verification requirements gating this phase's capstone. Populated once capstones are designed.
